title: FRESH: Information-Geometric Calibration of Patient-Level Models to Aggregate Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2605.16246v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This note introduces FRESH (Fusion of Recent Evidence and Subject Histories), a method for incorporating population-level summary results -- published clinical trials, registry summaries,   prior natural-history studies, and peer-reviewed indirect comparisons -- into predictive models trained on patient-level data. This method provides a principled means of combining both   patient-level and aggregate-level data types into a unified data-efficient model for clinical decision making.   FRESH assumes access to a generative model trained on patient-level data sources (e.g. clinical trial or real-world data). The method produces patient-level predictions from a re-calibrated   model that matches a set of specified aggregate statistics for a target population. translated_title: FRESH：基于信息几何的患者级模型对聚合证据的校准方法
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了FRESH（近期证据与个体历史融合，Fusion of Recent Evidence and Subject Histories），这是一种将人群层面的汇总结果——包括已发表的临床试验、登记系统汇总数据、既往自然史研究以及经同行评审的间接比较——纳入基于患者级数据训练的预测模型的方法。该方法提供了一种有原则的方式，将患者级和聚合级两种数据类型结合到统一的、数据高效的模型中，以支持临床决策。FRESH假设可以访问在患者级数据源（如临床试验或真实世界数据）上训练的生成模型。该方法通过对模型进行重新校准，使其匹配目标人群的一组指定汇总统计量，从而产生患者级预测。这可以理解为聚合数据来源在患者层面的重现——其关键特性在于重新校准是对原始联合分布的最小扰动。
tldr: FRESH提出了一种基于信息几何的校准方法，通过对患者级生成模型进行最小扰动，使其匹配人群级汇总证据（如已发表试验和登记数据），从而实现患者级数据与聚合数据的统一、高效建模以支持临床决策。
en_tdlr: FRESH is an information-geometric calibration method that minimally perturbs patient-level generative models to match specified population-level aggregate statistics, enabling principled fusion of patient-level and aggregate evidence for data-efficient clinical decision making.
